appliedScenePlan.consequence: a line of toppled boxes rolling across the floor toward the showroom windows, some bursting open to reveal printed map fragments
appliedScenePlan.nextHook: domino line of boxes bearing map fragments that read 'Berlin-Neukölln'

appliedScenePlan.nextHook: bent ventilation duct sagging toward center floor with merchandise curtain
